svg.title: Logical components of an AI agent
svg.desc: A user talks to the agent's user interface. Inside the agent, a core with the LLM, agent workflow, and a planner directing actors sits between the UI and memory, which holds internal RAG, session traces and long-term storage, and tool and system credentials. An action set covers read, write and execute. The core calls a tool gateway that reaches the external environment: web, computer, domain-specific environments, third-party services and external RAG. Other agents communicate with the agent.
